title: Java OOP & SOLID
intro: Java OOP interview questions are the single most common opener in any backend interview, from junior to staff. This module is organized as an elevation arc so a learner reads top-to-bottom and feels the level rise. T0 Fundamentals grounds you in what OOP is and why it exists as a response to procedural programming's failures, then walks the four pillars. T1 Core Mechanics covers the daily building blocks — this/super, constructor chaining, overloading vs overriding, static. T2 Internet-Famous is the canon nearly every interview asks: SOLID (the #1 most-asked design-principle set), abstract class vs interface, composition vs inheritance, cohesion and coupling, the Law of Demeter, and the equals/hashCode contract. T3 Applied Patterns moves to code you actually ship — default/static interface methods, the diamond problem, association/aggregation/composition, enums, immutability. T4 Production & Edge Cases separates a working developer from someone who's shipped: shallow vs deep copy, marker interfaces, SerialVersionUID, inner classes, anonymous vs lambda, the Object class methods. Every answer comes with a short code snippet, the trade-off the interviewer is listening for, and the follow-up they are likely to ask next.
